Created by: Elevation Solutions
Displays the Priority Item and the selected sibling application, then captures the reviewer’s Approve/Deny decision using the standard Zeta button bar pattern.

textTemplates.description: Reinforces that no updates have been saved yet and clearly instructs the reviewer how to proceed or go back before confirmation.
textTemplates.name: TT_Confirm_Action_Warning
textTemplates.text:
Select Submit to apply these changes.
Select cancel to return to the appication eligibility screen.

textTemplates.description: Yellow “heads up” callout summarizing the reviewer’s selection (Approve vs Deny) before saving updates.
textTemplates.name: TT_Confirm_Priority_Item_Outcome
textTemplates.text:
Confirm {!varActionChosen}
You are about to mark this priority item as {!varActionChosen} and stamp the selected sibling application.

textTemplates.description: Explains that no sibling student record was found and outlines the available actions: deny the priority or exit the process.
textTemplates.name: tt_Display_No_Sibling_Match_Instructions
textTemplates.text:
Action Required

Option 1 — Deny this priority:
Click Deny Priority to mark this sibling priority as denied and continue processing the application without it.

Option 2 — Exit the review:
Click Finish to cancel out of this eligibility review. No additional changes will be made.

textTemplates.description: Red callout shown when no Individual Applications are found for the matched sibling student in the applicant’s timeline. Displays the filters used.
textTemplates.name: TT_Error_No_Sibling_Applications_Found
textTemplates.text:
No sibling applications found.
A sibling student was matched, but no Individual Application records were found using the criteria below:
Sibling Student: {!Get_Sibling_Candidates_Student_Accounts.FirstName} {!Get_Sibling_Candidates_Student_Accounts.LastName}
Application Timeline: {!Get_Individual_Application.Application_Timeline__r.Name}
This means the sibling student does not have an Individual Application in the same timeline as the applicant.

textTemplates.description: Red callout shown when the sibling Student Account lookup returns no records. Displays the match criteria used from the Priority Item.
textTemplates.name: TT_Error_No_Sibling_Record_Found
textTemplates.text:
No sibling student record found.
The flow attempted to match a Student Account using the sibling details stored on the Priority Item:
First Name: {!varSiblingFirstName}
Last Name: {!varSiblingLastName}
Birthdate: {!varSiblingBirthdate}
If these values are incorrect or incomplete, update the Priority Item sibling details and try again.

textTemplates.description: Instructions for selecting the sibling Individual Application to stamp on the Priority Item.”
textTemplates.name: TT_Header_SiblingApplicationSelect
textTemplates.text:
Select the sibling application
Choose the correct sibling Individual Application below. This selection will be stamped on the Priority Item when you approve or deny.

textTemplates.name: TT_Header_SiblingATESelect
textTemplates.text: Select the sibling enrollment: Choose the correct Academic Term Enrollment record below; this will be stamped on the Priority Item upon approval or denial.

textTemplates.description: Reusable header block that displays the applicant’s name, grade applying to, and birthdate for reviewer context. Intended to be placed at the top of all validation subflow screens.
textTemplates.name: TT_Master_Header_ApplicantContext
textTemplates.text:
Applicant: {!Get_Individual_Application.Account.FirstName} {!Get_Individual_Application.Account.MiddleName} {!Get_Individual_Application.Account.LastName}

Grade Applying To: {!Get_Individual_Application.Grade_Applying_To__c}

Birthdate: {!Get_Individual_Application.Account.PersonBirthdate}

Primary Guardian: {!Get_Individual_Application.Guardian_1_Full_Name__c}

Secondary Guardian: {!Get_Individual_Application.Parent_Guardian_2_Full_Name__c}

School Start Age: {!Get_Individual_Application.School_Start_Age__c}

Address: {!Get_Individual_Application.Account.PersonMailingStreet}, {!Get_Individual_Application.Account.PersonMailingCity}, {!Get_Individual_Application.Account.PersonMailingState} {!Get_Individual_Application.Account.PersonMailingPostalCode}

textTemplates.description: used for when a valid CCR relationship was not found for student applying and sibling
textTemplates.name: tt_relationship_notfound
textTemplates.text:
Sibling Relationship Required

A matching sibling student was found, but no valid relationship exists between the two students.

Please create either a Student-Guardian or Sibling-Sibling relationship before continuing.

Open Current Student:
Open Current Student Record

Open Sibling Student:
Open Sibling Student Record

Create the relationship from the account record and then try again.

textTemplates.description: Displays an error message when a sibling student is matched but no Academic Term Enrollment records are found for that student. Instructs the reviewer that the sibling is not currently enrolled (or not enrolled in the relevant term).
textTemplates.name: TT_SiblingATE_NotFound
textTemplates.text:
No sibling enrollments found.
A sibling student was matched, but no Academic Term Enrollment records were found for this student:
Sibling Student: {!Get_Sibling_Candidates_Student_Accounts.FirstName} {!Get_Sibling_Candidates_Student_Accounts.LastName}
This means the sibling student does not have an active Academic Term Enrollment record and does not qualify for Sibling Attending priority.
